scope: Labelled origin supplements for October calendar names whose reviewed history gives no origin.
method: thin151.mjs 10-01 10-31 listed reviewed October histories without origin wording; r160-data.mjs + build-r160.mjs (generated by makebuild.mjs from the round 151 helpers and the O-blocks of rounds 152–160) wrote public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements-r160.js, merged by public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements.js. Lithuanian comparison names in two-stem notes are checked against the LT calendar (lt2check.cjs). Skipped: names whose reviewed history already explains the word (Ilma, Skaidris, Torolfs, Daiga group, Drosmis, Dainis, Mudra, Gaivilė, Arminas, Skirgaila, Mantas, Deimantė, Vesta, Heldur group), Ninele (a Soviet-era coinage), names without a secure base (Monija, Ainita, Elgita, Silvars, Dinija, Dināra, Erlends, Taīda, Modrīte, Ita, Uldze, Ulla, Karina, Alanta, Tanvilė, Aliodija, Švitrigaila, Gantas, Gilanda, Gytė, Liubartas, Vaiva) and recent EE register names. Rounds 159–162 share writer 1.9.132 and the audit research/namedays/round162-audit.json. Wording follows the 16 November rules (no sources, no Russian attribution).
